page.overview:
What is Ender Chest?

Ender chests are a type of chest whose contents are exclusive to each player, and can be accessed from anywhere in the world.

Unless the pickaxe is enchanted with Silk Touch, the ender chest drops only 8 with no eyes of ender.Ender chests will drop 8 obsidian when mined by hand or with any tool, despite obsidian itself only being obtainable with a diamond or netherite pickaxe.

Ender chests naturally generate alongside a chest in certain End city treasure rooms.

Ender chests can be opened by pressing the control. If a solid block is placed above an ender chest, it cannot open.
